Headline: Senior Operations Analyst at Brindle & Hart Logistics | demand forecasting, Python, SQL, dbt
Summary: I turn warehouse, transport and supplier data into forecasts and decisions that move stock and vans. At Brindle & Hart Logistics I built weekly demand-forecasting models in Python and SQL across 2,400 SKUs and six distribution centres, cutting forecast error from 22% to 14%, and rebuilt the warehouse data feed as dbt models with data-quality tests. Before that I modelled shelf-life and order patterns for chilled lines at Oakmere Foods, where write-offs fell 18%, and started on a graduate scheme at Saltmarsh Analytics. I like problems where a model changes what a warehouse does the next morning.
